verify.cmd: node -e 'let d;try{d=require("./scripts/lib/ledger.mjs").loadBacklog(".")}catch(e){console.error(String(e));process.exit(79)}const by=new Map(d.entries.map((e)=>[e.id,e]));const bad=[];const parked=(e,trig)=>e.status==="parked"&&/parkedUntil/.test(e.notes||"")&&/ADR-1682/.test(e.notes||"")&&trig.test(e.notes||"")&&/REVISIT TRIGGER/.test(e.detail||"");const reopened=(e)=>(e.status==="open"||e.status==="blocked")&&/REOPENED 2026-09-30 \(ADR-1703/.test(e.detail||"");const closedSince=(e)=>e.status==="done"&&String(e.closed||"")>="2026-09-30"&&/REOPENED 2026-09-30 \(ADR-1703/.test(e.detail||"");const want=(what,trig,ids)=>{for(const id of ids){const e=by.get(id);if(!e)bad.push(id+" is gone");else if(!parked(e,trig)&&!reopened(e)&&!closedSince(e))bad.push(id+" is "+e.status+", the 2026-09-30 ruling says "+what)}};want("parked with the native app",/native app build/,["LIVE-714","LIVE-716","LIVE-717","LIVE-718","LIVE-719","LIVE-720","LIVE-721","LIVE-722","LIVE-723","LIVE-726"]);want("parked until after launch",/after launch/,["PROG-GD6","LIVE-693","LIVE-664","LIVE-665","LIVE-667","LIVE-708","LIVE-671","LIVE-673","LIVE-663","LIVE-682","LIVE-669","LIVE-668","LIVE-676","LIVE-677","LIVE-675","LIVE-679","LIVE-678","LIVE-690","LIVE-691","LIVE-662","LIVE-658","LIVE-710","LIVE-692","LIVE-695"]);const dm=by.get("DEF-MOBILE");if(!dm||dm.status!=="parked"||!/LIVE-726/.test(dm.notes||""))bad.push("DEF-MOBILE is not parked naming the ten readiness rows");if(bad.length){console.error("HYG-157: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}console.log("ok: 10 iOS readiness rows parked with the native app, 24 P3 rows parked until after launch, each with parkedUntil and its trigger")'
verify.note: Reads the merged ledger view (ADR-1635) in-process: the ten iOS readiness rows are parked with a parkedUntil note naming the native app build, the 24 P3 rows are parked with a parkedUntil note naming after launch, every one cites ADR-1682 in its notes and carries a REVISIT TRIGGER in its detail, and DEF-MOBILE is parked naming the ten. Fails on main at bef0a6edf, where all 34 are open. About 160 ms CPU. AMENDED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1703): a row the owner reopened that day, open with ADR-1703's REOPENED paragraph in its detail, counts as ruled; every other arm is unchanged. ── 2026-10-05: a row the 2026-09-30 ruling reopened may since have CLOSED by a later owner ruling (LIVE-693 retired, ADR-1704 §3); a done row with a closed date on or after 2026-09-30 that carries the REOPENED paragraph counts as accounted for, so the pin keeps measuring the ruling without holding a retired row open forever.

append.detail: ── PROBE AMENDED 2026-10-05 (owner-gated prep PR). LIVE-693, one of the 24 rows this pin holds as parked-or-reopened, was retired by owner ruling (ADR-1704 §3).
